meta.title: Interject and side chat
meta.description: An interject button beside the composer that drops a message into the running turn, and a collapsible right-hand discussion panel that keeps its own separate conversation.

interject.title: Interject into the running turn
interject.hint: Your message reaches the current turn at its next step — no need to wait for it to finish.
interject.placeholder: Type a remark, a correction, or a question…
interject.sentQueued: The turn already finished, so this went out as the next message.

dialog.heading: Side discussion
dialog.empty: A private channel for working out a disagreement. It runs on its own conversation, so nothing here disturbs the main thread.
dialog.placeholder: What do you disagree with, or want to think through?
